scope: Installation of one explicitly selected prefabricated underground GRP wet-well sewage pumping station SPS-GRP-D2400-H6500-Q45-H18-2D1S for 45 l/s at 18 m head. The 2400 mm x 6500 mm wet well and three Flygt-N-3153-22KW submersible pumps in a two-duty plus one-standby arrangement are known scope; station components, civil quantities, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics remain direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved wastewater hydraulic and structural designer, pumping-station manufacturer, pump and controls suppliers, electrical testing laboratory and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: external gravity or pressure pipeline, manholes, off-site power supply, unselected building or treatment-process equipment
material, civil, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from station count, flow, head or dimensions
automatic bypass pumping, dewatering or odor control
universal retained spare or supplier-package quantity
